outcome: Add offline timestamped audio-track transcription to the harness perception tools, with attributable and revisable evidence.
criteria: An optional local ASR model transcribes bounded video-audio clips through MCP, retaining source, audio, model and timestamp provenance without backend model code or wheel dependencies.
Transcript segments can be imported through existing backend tools and cited in revisable agent observations; configuration, scope, missing audio, timing and failure behavior have focused coverage.

Prepare the local transcription runtime and weights, exercise the real task_312 audio track through the new tool and host integration, and document observed results and remaining limits without task-specific transcription prompts.

dispositions.note: Added opt-in offline audio-track MCP transcription with bounded clips, source/audio/model hashes, video-clock segment timestamps, raw ASR and isolated timed workers. Backend code and wheel dependencies remain unchanged.

Speech segments import through the existing backend surface and can be cited alone or with frames in explicitly revised observations. 259 repository tests passed with two machine FFmpeg skips; all 12 perception tests passed in the container, including actual multi-track and delayed-stream alignment. Mixed frame/speech import also passed.

Copied and SHA256-verified all eight files in the user-supplied medium and tiny models into .cache/asr/champion without touching the sources. The copied medium model transcribed task_312 into 12 segments in 23.75 seconds; OpenCode imported the 12-row result. Additional network-disabled checks validated a nonzero-start clip and empty output for synthetic silence. The final audio image registered its tools and verified weights offline.

note: The earlier downloaded medium duplicate finished before the user supplied the local path; it was unused and removed after its hashes matched the copied source. Documentation records model/runtime identity, local source paths, evidence layout and recognition errors. The integration was an audio check rather than another benchmark score. Raw ASR and estimated timestamps remain separate from revisable agent interpretations, and critical terms still require review against the media.
